note: Breitung Township campground on the south shore of Lake Vermilion, built around a swimming beach with docks, a boat launch and a fish-cleaning house. Sites 50-55 line the shore north-east of the beach, about 15-25 m from the water behind a thin band of shoreline trees; the west loop is mostly seasonal. --Claude
summary: Township and campground pages + 2026 rate PDF read: electric $55/day, non-electric $35, extra person $5 past 4; 61 sites (26 seasonal, 8 tent); phone/email booking, no Saturday arrivals; May 1-Sep 30; showers, store, laundry, dump. Derived 50 A / water cleared (unstated). Lakeview kept (sites 50-55 ~15-25 m behind shoreline trees). Phone 218-780-6860 -> 218-753-5921. Second website moved. Pin OK.
flags: Phone: 218-780-6860 -> 218-753-5921 (on every page of mckinleyparkcampground.com, the township page 'Call 218-753-5921 ... for reservations' and Google). The stored number appears on none of them.

Website: second line https://www.breitungtownship.org/attractions/mckinley-park-campground/ now redirects to the township's new home page https://breitungtownshipmn.gov/ ; replace it with https://breitungtownshipmn.gov/mckinley-park-campground/ . First line https://mckinleyparkcampground.com/ works.

Waterfront: lakeview KEPT after a hard check. On the campground map sites 50-55 sit between the camp road and Lake Vermilion north-east of the swimming beach; imagery shows RVs on that lane about 15-25 m from the shore (around 47.8285,-92.2729 to 47.8293,-92.2723) with a thin band of shoreline trees and brush between them and the water, so a view rather than lakefront (and it is unknown whether those six are nightly or seasonal). Sites 36 and 38 sit by the dock and boat launch (day use between). The west loop (map 'SEASONAL SITES' and tent sites 22-27) is behind a tree band along the shore. The open lawn by the beach is day use.

Long-stay: 26 of 60-61 sites are seasonal ($4,000 season lease, 'Guests may not stay in the unit unless one of the seasonal campers on the lease agreement is present') and 8 are primitive tent sites, so roughly 26 sites are sold by the day/week/month; daily rentals open March 1 after monthly (Feb 1) and weekly (Feb 15). Not mostly seasonal on these counts (about 43% seasonal); nights are sold with a posted daily rate. Township-run (no concessionaire); Google 4.4 from 85 reviews.

Booking: 'No Saturday arrivals' (2026 rates PDF; the rules page says 'There are no Saturday Check-ins'), in booking.note. Booking is by phone; the online system at reservations.mckinleyparkcampground.com needs an account (rates are posted publicly, so this is not a login-to-see-rates problem).

Fees: kept the $55 electric rate as the base; the $35 non-electric rate is not used as the low because the pages don't say a 23-ft motorhome may use a non-electric site (the only non-electric sites they describe are the 8 primitive tent sites). Extra person: included 4, $5 a person; the PDF doesn't say per night or per stay, so 'per' is left out.
Hookups: electric 50 and water true (from note prose) cleared; the pages say only 'Electric'. A reviewer may set electric if the hosts confirm an amperage.
Pin 47.82710,-92.27300 sits by the office/playground ~100 m from Google's pin; OK.
